title: Quality of Upcoming New Jobs in Tech and IT Sector
what_it_is: Quality of Upcoming New Jobs in Tech and IT Sector

sections.label: Infocomm job vacancies 2014
sections.summary: The 15,000 vacancies in 2014 were unchanged from 2013, an average vacancy rate of 9%, across sectors including banking and finance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The 15,000 vacancies in 2014 were unchanged from 2013 and translate to an average vacancy rate of 9%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: These vacancies were not just from the tech and information technology (IT) sector, but also from companies in other sectors, such as banking and finance, that employ infocomm professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: More than two-thirds of these vacancies were for professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) or technical specialists in areas, such as development, network and infrastructure, cybersecurity and data analytics.

sections.label: Growing demand for technical specialists
sections.summary: Demand for technical specialists grew 6.3% annually from 2011 to 2014 and is expected to continue given Singapore's Smart Nation push.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Demand for technical specialists has been growing by 6.3% annually from 2011 to 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We expect this growth to continue, given Singapore's push towards becoming a Smart Nation.
